value: estimated upper frequency limit of hearing 153 kHz, which the authors say was possibly an underestimate
method: auditory evoked potentials (SAM-tone auditory steady-state response); threshold defined as the SPL of the lowest detected ASSR; upper frequency limit defined as the highest frequency corresponding to an interpolated threshold of 120 dB re 1 µPa
conditions: one neonate female pygmy sperm whale (SWCKb1701b, n=1) stranded on La Jolla Shores Beach, San Diego, California, on 28 July 2017; a full audiogram was not obtained; thresholds were higher than in the dwarf sperm whale; not a behavioural audiogram; sedation and testing details for this animal were not read
